unmapped_files.why: FastQC reports on the raw reads; their numbers are read through MultiQC.
fgbio FastqToBam's unmapped BAM: the raw reads with their UMIs in the RX tag, an intermediate of consensus calling.
fgbio CorrectUmis' corrected and rejected BAMs and its metrics (only for rows with a umi_file): intermediates of consensus calling.
The raw reads aligned and template-coordinate sorted for grouping: an intermediate, not the consensus result.
Raw-read BAMs of one library merged across lanes or flowcells: an intermediate of grouping.
fgbio GroupReadsByUmi's grouped BAM (raw reads tagged with their molecule) and its family-size table: intermediates of consensus calling; the family sizes are read through MultiQC.
The unmapped consensus reads (--mode rd), before alignment and filtering: the aln rule registers the filtered, aligned consensus.

--mode rd: the consensus aligned before FilterConsensusReads, so the aln rule's filtered BAM supersedes it. --mode ht writes its final, aligned consensus here instead, which this map does not register: the launch template offers --mode rd only (see the README, fastquorum).
fgbio CollectDuplexSeqMetrics' per-library family-size, UMI-count and yield tables and their PDF (with --duplex_seq): no sample type has attributes for them, and MultiQC does not read them.
MultiQC's data tables; the harvest reads them itself, they are not results to register.
Run provenance (software versions, params, execution reports), read by the harvest, not registered.
